I strongly advise against purchasing this suitcase. I was incredibly disappointed from the moment I took it out of the box. First, the product description is misleading. The photos advertise a crisp, white suitcase, but the actual product is a dull off-white color. Worse than the color mismatch is the appalling lack of quality control. The suitcase arrived looking damaged and hastily thrown together. Here is exactly what I found right out of the packaging: • Scuff marks and dirt in multiple spots across the exterior shell. • Terrible finishing around the zipper: The ends are very badly glued, and the rubber sealing is already separating and peeling off. • Visible debris: Bizarrely, there is literally a piece of masking tape and loose threads visibly sticking out from under the rubber trim. The only reason I am not returning this immediately is because I have an urgent trip and simply do not have the time to wait for a replacement. I am completely stuck with a damaged, poorly manufactured product. Do yourself a favor and spend your money elsewhere. The quality is completely unacceptable, and it looks nothing like the item advertised. Avoid this product!

I recently purchased the American Tourister Ivy 78 Cms Large Check-in Polypropylene (PP) trolley, and I must say that I am thoroughly disappointed with its performance. Despite its promising features, this suitcase failed to meet my expectations in several key areas. First and foremost, the build quality of this trolley is subpar. The polypropylene material used feels cheap and flimsy, making me question its durability. Within just a few uses, I noticed visible scratches and scuff marks on the surface, which is unacceptable for a product that is meant to endure the rigors of travel. Furthermore, the wheels on this trolley are a major letdown. They lack smoothness and maneuverability, making it a struggle to navigate through crowded airports or uneven surfaces. The wheels frequently jammed and became stiff, adding unnecessary frustration to my travel experience. I expected better performance from a reputable brand like American Tourister. Additionally, the handle mechanism was poorly designed. It felt flimsy and had a noticeable wobble, which made it uncomfortable to pull the trolley. I had concerns about its longevity and worried that it might break during my travels. A reliable handle is essential for a check-in suitcase, and the American Tourister Ivy failed to deliver in this aspect. Lastly, the overall aesthetics of the trolley were uninspiring. The design lacked innovation and appeared outdated. For the price I paid, I expected a more stylish and modern look. It is disappointing when a product not only underperforms in terms of functionality but also fails to make a positive impression visually. In conclusion, the American Tourister Ivy 78 Cms Large Check-in Polypropylene (PP) trolley fell short of my expectations. Its poor build quality, subpar wheels, flimsy handle, and unappealing aesthetics make it difficult for me to recommend this product. I regret my purchase and would advise potential buyers to explore other options before settling for this particular suitcase
